tuning: See snapshot notes — Snapshots 1+2 standard tuning (Jonny), Snapshots 3+4 Drop D (Thom)
notes: Combined Jonny Greenwood and Thom Yorke parts in a single preset with four snapshots. Snapshots 1+2 cover Jonny's lead/riff part (standard tuning, Boss OD-3 via Stupor OD, Boss RE-20 slapback). Snapshots 3+4 cover Thom's rhythm guitar part (Drop D, MXR Distortion+ via Top Secret OD, minimal slapback). Signal chain uses only 5 blocks — Stupor OD and Top Secret OD alternate active/bypassed states across snapshot pairs, sharing the same Noise Gate, EQ, and Transistor Tape blocks. If playing both parts in the same session, tune to Drop D and use a capo at the 2nd fret for Snapshots 1+2 (Jonny part) to restore effective standard pitch — or retune between snapshots. Confirmed sources: Jools Holland January 2008 for Thom; From The Basement for Jonny.

signal_chain.notes: Shared across all snapshots. Thom snapshots (S3+S4) are slightly tighter — Top Secret OD at high Gain generates more noise than Stupor OD.

Jonny's Boss OD-3 approximation. ACTIVE in Snapshots 1+2 only. BYPASSED in Snapshots 3+4 (Thom's part uses Top Secret OD instead). Confirmed: Jonny does not adjust pedals during the song — Drive stays constant, only dynamics from picking hand change the intensity.

Thom's MXR Distortion+ approximation — both use the same LM741 op-amp clipping circuit. Only two parameters: Gain and Level. BYPASSED in Snapshots 1+2 (Jonny's part). ACTIVE in Snapshots 3+4 only. Confirmed via Jools Holland January 2008 performance.

CRITICAL DIFFERENCE between Jonny and Thom snapshots: Thom's part is in Drop D — Low Cut must be raised to 120-140Hz to prevent open D string from becoming muddy under distortion. Jonny's part (standard tuning) uses a lower Low Cut of 100Hz. Both share a mid-forward character compensating for removed Essex A30 voicing but at different frequencies. Thom's mid boost is more aggressive and lower in frequency (600-650Hz) matching the confrontational chorus character.

Shared slapback block. Confirmed: Jonny used Boss RE-20 Space Echo for slapback (one repeat, fast delay time). Thom's confirmed rig has NO delay — very low Mix on Thom snapshots (S3: 18%, S4: 12%) approximates the slightly larger-than-life studio quality when Godrich ran Thom's guitar direct into console. Transistor Tape optional for Thom snapshots — can be bypassed in S3+S4 if desired. Tempo-synced to 166 BPM. Sixteenth note = 90ms (original targets: Jonny 95ms, Thom 85ms — both within 5ms of synced value, use synced).
signal_chain.optional_for_thom: Transistor Tape can be bypassed in Snapshots 3+4 since Thom's confirmed rig has no delay

tuning_strategy.option_1: Retune between Jonny (S1+S2) and Thom (S3+S4) snapshots — most accurate
tuning_strategy.option_2: Stay in Drop D throughout, use capo at 2nd fret for Snapshots 1+2 to restore effective standard pitch on Jonny riff (approximate — Jonny plays standard tuning)
tuning_strategy.option_3: Play only one part per session — use S1+S2 for Jonny or S3+S4 for Thom

1_jonny_verse.description: Jonny — verse/main riff. Standard tuning. Stupor OD at Drive 5.5. Top Secret OD bypassed. Low Cut 100Hz. Mid +3dB at 700Hz. Slapback 22% mix.

2_jonny_chorus.description: Jonny — chorus/bridge. Standard tuning. Stupor OD pushed to Drive 7.0. Tighter Low Cut 120Hz. More aggressive mid +4dB at 650Hz. Slapback drops to 18% mix.

3_thom_verse.description: Thom — verse/main riff. DROP D. Stupor OD bypassed. Top Secret OD at Gain 6.5. Low Cut raised to 120Hz for Drop D. Mid +3dB at 650Hz. Slapback at 18% mix (optional — Thom's confirmed rig has no delay).

4_thom_chorus.description: Thom — chorus/bridge. DROP D. Top Secret OD pushed to Gain 8.0. Low Cut tightened to 140Hz. Aggressive mid +5dB at 600Hz. Slapback minimal at 12% mix. Most confrontational tone in the preset.

tuning_per_part.thom_snapshots_3_4: Drop D — tune low E string down to D

playing_notes.jonny_technique: Fast aggressive single-note riff pattern. Killswitch stutter effect approximated by quick palm mutes. Confirmed: Jonny does not touch pedals during the song. Bridge pickup.
playing_notes.thom_technique: Power chords and open string riffs using low D string as pedal tone. Physically aggressive playing — the recording was a 12-hour hyperactive session. Bridge pickup.
playing_notes.comparison: Jonny uses Stupor OD (SD-1/OD-3 character — smoother, transparent overdrive). Thom uses Top Secret OD (Distortion+/OD-250 character — darker, more compressed). Together in a band context these create complementary distortion layers.
playing_notes.snapshot_cues: Verse sections: FS1 (Jonny) or FS3 (Thom). Chorus sections: FS2 (Jonny) or FS4 (Thom). If playing alone covering one part, ignore the unused snapshot pair.
playing_notes.blocks_saved: Consolidation reduced from 8 blocks across 2 presets to 5 blocks in 1 preset — 3 blocks saved by sharing Noise Gate, Parametric EQ, and Transistor Tape across both parts.
